subject: MAP: Target close & procurement timeline - draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@fintechco.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Target close & procurement timeline - draft

Hi Claire & Michael,

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for a productive discovery. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, and target dates so we have a single source of truth for the next 6 weeks. High level:

- Target close date (commercial go/no-go): 2026-09-30
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-09-22 (we put this a week before the target close to allow for legal/ops handoff)

Draft MAP milestones (owners / dates):
1) Finalize technical POC requirements — Owner: FinTechCo (Claire) — Due: 2026-08-20
2) Redwood POC delivery & validation — Owner: Redwood (Camila) — Due: 2026-09-03
3) Security & compliance evidence (SOC 2 + data flow diagram) — Owner: Redwood (Connor) — Due: 2026-09-08
4) Procurement & legal review (contract redlines) — Owner: FinTechCo Legal/Procurement — Due: 2026-09-15
5) Contract signature — Owner: FinTechCo / Redwood — Due: 2026-09-22
6) Production onboarding plan & kickoff — Owner: Redwood/FinTechCo — Due: 2026-09-30

Dependencies / notes:
- Procurement typically needs the SOC 2 report + a short SOW to begin review (we've listed Connor as point for SOC2 evidence).
- If the procurement review window slips, the contract signature date will move and push the target close.

Could you confirm the procurement review window on your side and whether 2026-09-22 is realistic for signature? If that date looks tight, tell me the latest signature date you can commit to and we'll adjust the MAP and milestone owners.

Next steps:
- I’ll share the MAP in Google Drive and update based on your procurement feedback.
- Proposed weekly 30-min sync on Fridays to keep the MAP current (first sync 2026-08-14).

Attached: FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_20260810.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0147
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Target close & procurement timeline - draft

Marissa — quick internal note after looking through the draft MAP:

- Timeline looks good overall. One risk to call out: FinTechCo procurement almost always requests a 2-week legal review window once they have the SOW + vendor evidence.
- They also typically request SOC 2 Type II or equivalent evidence; Connor, can you confirm we have the latest SOC 2 package and DFD ready to share by 2026-09-08?

If procurement needs the extra window, we should be prepared to move the procurement signature deadline to 2026-09-25 and bump target close to 2026-10-01. Otherwise, keep as-is and push staffing on our side to meet the original dates.

Camila
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Johnson <claire@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@fintechco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Target close & procurement timeline - draft

Thanks, Marissa — good recap and appreciate the MAP. A few notes from procurement/legal:

- Procurement has confirmed they need at least two full weeks for contract review once they receive the SOW and vendor security evidence.
- Our Legal team prefers to allow a 3-business-day internal redline window, then 5 business days back-and-forth with vendor counsel.

Given those constraints, procurement is asking if we can move the contract signature deadline to 2026-09-28 and the target close to 2026-10-01. That gives them room for the internal reviews and potential redlines.

Can you update the MAP to reflect the adjusted signature deadline (2026-09-28) and confirm who will be the Redwood contact for legal redlines? Also, please share your standard SOW template so we can start internal review.

Attached: FinTechCo_procurement_checklist.xlsx

Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Target close & procurement timeline - draft

Claire — thanks for the procurement read. Confirmed and updated below. We've incorporated your ask into MAP v2 and adjusted milestones:

Updated dates:
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-09-28
- Target close date: 2026-10-01

Updated milestone owners (high level):
- SOC 2 + evidence delivery — Owner: Connor Obrien (Redwood) — Due: 2026-09-08
- SOW + commercial terms submission — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) — Due: 2026-09-10
- Procurement review period — Owner: FinTechCo Procurement — 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-25
- Contract redline window & finalization — Owners: FinTechCo Legal / Redwood Legal (Connor) — Complete by 2026-09-28

Next steps:
1) I attached an updated MAP (FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_v2_20260814.pdf) that reflects the new dates.
2) Connor — please prepare the SOC 2 package and DFD and confirm you can share by 2026-09-08.
3) Claire / Procurement — we will send the SOW and initial commercial redlines via DocuSign for visibility. I’ll include a DocuSign link and request a 5-business-day turnaround on redlines to stay on the new timeline.

DocuSign link for redline window: https://www.docusign.com/FinTechCo/FT-2026-0921/redline
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FT-2026-0921

If that looks good, I’ll lock the MAP and send calendar invites for the weekly Friday sync (first sync 2026-08-14).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Best regards,
